categories.main_business_segments: Nohmi Bosai Ltd. operates primarily in three business segments: fire alarm systems, fire extinguishing systems, and maintenance/inspection services. The company also engages in related activities such as design, R&D, building management, and provides additional safety-related solutions, including parking control and security equipment through subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies are based on early fire detection and extinguishing methods, underpinned by foundational fire science research. Key innovations include advanced smoke detection systems (such as ultra-sensitive smoke monitoring with color discrimination), integration of drones for high-altitude detector testing, and comprehensive fire prevention system design and manufacturing. Production emphasizes quality control and compliance with strict safety standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Nohmi Bosai serves a broad range of customers, primarily in the construction, real estate, public infrastructure, and industrial sectors. Its end markets include new and renovated buildings, high-rise structures, plants, tunnels, and public facilities, with a focus on both private and public sector clients. The company also supplies products on an OEM basis to its parent company, Secom.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are centered in Japan, which accounts for over 90% of sales and assets, but it also has a presence in China, Taiwan, and India through subsidiaries and affiliates. Most manufacturing and R&D facilities are located in Japan, with some production and sales activities in Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nohmi Bosai operates primarily as a midstream and downstream player in the supply chain, manufacturing fire safety equipment and systems, installing them, and providing ongoing maintenance and inspection services. It also acts as an OEM supplier for certain products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company is focused on expanding its core business, improving profitability, and pursuing growth through M&A in adjacent safety fields. R&D priorities include digital transformation, advanced fire detection technologies, decarbonization solutions, and new business creation. The company is also investing in sustainability, workforce development, and supply chain resilience.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale and installation of fire alarm and extinguishing systems, as well as recurring income from maintenance, inspection, and repair services. Additional revenue streams include OEM supply, equipment sales, and related safety solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nohmi Bosai is a leading player and pioneer in Japan’s fire safety industry, with a strong market position and brand recognition. Its main competitors include other major fire protection system manufacturers and engineering firms, but it differentiates itself through integrated solutions and a comprehensive service network.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales reached ¥133.7 billion, with operating profit of ¥15.7 billion and net profit attributable to shareholders of ¥11.1 billion. The company has shown steady growth, achieving record sales and exceeding mid-term targets, and aims for further expansion to ¥170 billion in sales and a 12% operating margin by FY2029.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nohmi Bosai emphasizes its ability to provide end-to-end, integrated fire safety solutions—from R&D to maintenance—backed by over a century of expertise and innovation. Its value proposition centers on reliability, advanced technology, compliance with stringent safety standards, and a strong service network, aiming to deliver 'zero fire damage' and contribute to a safer, more sustainable society.
